summary: Iteration_5 verifies TaxiOS v2.0 Phase 1 (a Plattform-Provision 7%/5%, c Stornierungs-Protokoll, d priceExact + Quick-Win flat/wrapped GET shape) end-to-end. Backend pytest: 36/36 PASS (16 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_commission_cancel.py + 20 regression from iteration_3+4). All commission/cancellation endpoints work as specified: company cityTier persistence BIG/SMALL + invalid rejected; /api/admin/overview returns today+month {trips,revenue,platformFee,net,avgFare}+cancellations30d+company.cityTier; /api/super/overview totals include grossRevenue/platformFee/companyNet/completedTrips/cancellations30d AND per-company commissionRate=0.07 for BIG; customer POST /api/bookings/:id/cancel works for SUCHE, returns 404 for unknown id, 409 if already cancelled; admin POST /api/admin/bookings/:id/cancel works for own company, returns 403 cross-company, 401 unauthenticated; admin GET /api/admin/bookings/:id/cancellations returns logs with actorType=ADMIN. GET /api/bookings/:id correctly returns BOTH flat (id, status,...) AND wrapped 'booking' key. DTO includes priceExact, isReserved, platformFee, companyNet, platformFeeRate, cancelledAt, cancelledBy, cancelReason. FRONTEND e2e: /registrieren shows register-citytier-small (default selected) + register-citytier-big with working toggle. /super-admin (super@taxios.app/<PASSWORT-ENTFERNT>) shows platform-financials box with fin-gross/fin-fee/fin-net/fin-trips + per-company rows super-company-<slug> with cityTier badge ('Großstadt 7%' / 'Klein/Land 5%'). /admin shows commission-card with kpi-fee-today, kpi-fee-month, kpi-net-month, Tarifstufe='Großstadt 7%', plus 30d-Stornos counter. /verfolgen/<id> shows row-price-range='Preisschätzung 6,39 € – 8,17 €' when priceExact is null (correct). However TWO frontend bugs were found related to spec (c) and (b) – see frontend_issues.

ui_bugs.issue: cancel-booking button is NOT rendered in JSX. The cancelBooking() function + cancelling/cancelError state exist (lines 21-57) but no <button data-testid='cancel-booking'> exists anywhere in the render output. Customer cannot cancel a booking from the UI. Spec requires the button to be visible when status ∈ {SUCHE, RESERVIERT_FAHRER, FAHRER_GEFUNDEN, FAHRER_UNTERWEGS, GEPLANT} and cancelError should display when set.

Spec requires banner text 'Ihr Fahrer beendet aktuell noch eine andere Fahrt und kommt anschließend direkt zu Ihnen.' when trackingStatus='RESERVIERT_FAHRER'. Only the step label 'Fahrer beendet aktuell noch eine Fahrt' exists in TRACKING_LABEL. The status banner itself only shows the label without the customer-facing explanation paragraph.

action_items: Add the missing cancel-booking button into TrackingView.tsx JSX. It should render after the status banner (or in a card near the booking details), be visible only when trackingStatus is one of {SUCHE,RESERVIERT_FAHRER,FAHRER_GEFUNDEN,FAHRER_UNTERWEGS,GEPLANT} (matching the backend allow-list which blocks FAHRER_ANGEKOMMEN/FAHRT_LAEUFT/BEENDET/ABGESCHLOSSEN/STORNIERT), call cancelBooking() on click, be disabled while cancelling=true, and render cancelError below when set. Suggested location: inside the booking-details card OR as a standalone btn-ghost below the map.

Add the RESERVIERT_FAHRER banner subtitle text 'Ihr Fahrer beendet aktuell noch eine andere Fahrt und kommt anschließend direkt zu Ihnen.' inside the tracking-banner when status='RESERVIERT_FAHRER' (similar pattern to the 'Einen Fahrer suchen…' subtext used for SUCHE on lines 184-189).
(Optional, nice-to-have) Once the cancel-booking button is added, add a Playwright e2e that clicks it on a fresh booking and asserts banner switches to red 'Storniert'.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: TrackingView.tsx defines cancelBooking + state but never renders the trigger – pure dead code / missing UI integration. Was probably forgotten when wiring the JSX.
GOOD: /api/admin/bookings/:id/cancel correctly enforces companyId match (403 cross-company) and rejects unauth (401). CancellationLog persistence verified via GET endpoint.
GOOD: Customer cancel route correctly blocks FAHRER_ANGEKOMMEN/FAHRT_LAEUFT/BEENDET with 409 'Stornierung nicht mehr möglich – der Fahrer ist bereits am Abholort.'
GOOD: GET /api/bookings/:id returns spread {...dto, booking: dto} so flat + wrapped consumers both work – clean backward-compat solution.

NOTE: bookings/[id]/cancel triggers dispatcher.cancelBooking() which is responsible for writing the CancellationLog row + setting booking.cancelledBy/cancelledAt/cancelReason – not tested at lower level here, but observable side effects all verified via DB read-back.

success_rate.frontend: 80% – 4 of the 5 UI specs pass (citytier buttons, super-admin platform-financials, admin commission-card, row-price-range). The 5th (cancel-booking button + RESERVIERT_FAHRER banner subtitle) is broken because the button is not in the JSX and the banner subtitle is missing.

rca of the issue: TrackingView.tsx cancel-booking bug: developer added function cancelBooking + state cancelling/cancelError (lines 21-57) but forgot to add the actual <button> in the JSX (lines 148-313). The DOM has zero elements with data-testid='cancel-booking'. Fix: add e.g. `{['SUCHE','RESERVIERT_FAHRER','FAHRER_GEFUNDEN','FAHRER_UNTERWEGS','GEPLANT'].includes(status) && <button data-testid='cancel-booking' disabled={cancelling} onClick={cancelBooking} className='btn-ghost text-red-600'>{cancelling ? 'Storniere…' : 'Fahrt stornieren'}</button>}` plus error rendering. Reproduction: navigate to /verfolgen/<id> for a SUCHE booking → button absent. Mitigation: pure additive JSX, no API change required.
